query: I am an umbrella organization/NGO representing civil society. I am interested in climate change. What are the opportunities for an organization like me?
response:
As an NGO representing civil society in the climate change domain, your organization is highly eligible for Horizon Europe funding, particularly in areas focused on citizen engagement, societal readiness, policy support, and dissemination. Non-profit public bodies and NGOs are eligible for a **100% funding rate** on eligible costs (RIA/IA/CSA).

Funding opportunities in this area are typically multidisciplinary, primarily falling under **Cluster 5, Cluster 6, and the EU Missions.**

### 1. Most Relevant Open Calls (Climate Change & Societal Engagement)

The search identified several key upcoming and open topics where civil society participation is specifically encouraged, particularly in the framework of the EU Missions and Societal Readiness actions:

| ID | Title (Abbreviated) | Cluster/Mission | Type | Status | Relevance for NGO | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **HORIZON-MISS-2026-01** | Mission: Climate Adaptation support for regions | EU Mission | CSA | Upcoming (Deadline: Mar 2026) | **HIGH**. Scope specifically requires participatory approach, collaboration, and engagement with local communities and citizens.
| **HORIZON-CL5-2026-02-D4-02** | Smarter buildings as part of the energy system – Societal Readiness Pilot | Cluster 5 | IA/Pilot | Open (Deadline: Feb 2026) | **HIGH**. Societal Readiness Pilots (SRP) focus on maximizing the uptake of innovations by end-users and require strong social science and public engagement components.
| **HORIZON-CL5-2026-02-D4-03** | Innovative pathways for low carbon and climate resilient building stock | Cluster 5 | IA | Open (Deadline: Feb 2026) | Relevant for driving market and societal adoption of green building practices.
| **HORIZON-CL6-2025-02-FARM2FORK-19** | Agroecology Living Labs for climate action | Cluster 6 | RIA/IA | Open (2025) | Relevant for NGOs involved in land use, agriculture, and community-based climate solutions.

### 2. Primary Funding Areas for Climate NGOs

Your organization can seek funding across the following main areas, where your expertise in stakeholder mobilization and impact delivery is essential:

#### A. EU Missions (Targeted Impact)

EU Missions are challenge-driven and provide excellent opportunities for civil society organizations to lead or participate in implementation and outreach activities (often funded as CSAs).

| Mission | Focus | Typical NGO Role | 
|---|---|---|
| **Adaptation to Climate Change** | Supporting 150+ EU regions to become climate-resilient by 2030. | Leading citizen engagement, climate risk communication, developing regional adaptation pathways, and policy advocacy.
| **Restore our Ocean and Waters** | Protecting and restoring marine and freshwater ecosystems. | Public awareness campaigns, citizen science, monitoring pollution, engaging local stakeholders (fishermen, coastal communities).
| **A Soil Deal for Europe** | 100 living labs for healthy soils. | Mobilizing farmers and land managers, promoting sustainable land use, educational activities, and living lab coordination.

#### B. Cluster 5: Climate, Energy & Mobility

This cluster focuses on climate science, decarbonization, and systemic changes.

*   **Relevant Areas:** Climate science and services, public acceptance of clean technologies, sustainable mobility planning, societal readiness for the energy transition, and just transition research.

#### C. Cluster 6: Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources

This cluster addresses the environmental and sustainable management aspects of climate change.

*   **Relevant Areas:** Biodiversity protection, circular economy, sustainable water management, environmental monitoring (often using citizen science data), and governance frameworks.

### 3. Action Type Recommendations

| Action Type | Typical NGO Role | Funding Rate | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CSA (Coordination & Support Actions)** | **Ideal.** Leading dissemination, communication, stakeholder mapping, policy recommendations, and coordinating large networks. | 100% | Shorter proposal (30 pages), lower total budget (typically €1-3M).
| **RIA (Research & Innovation Actions)** | Leading work packages on social science, governance, stakeholder engagement, and impact assessment. | 100% | Standard research projects (45 pages), typical budget €3-8M.
| **IA (Innovation Actions)** | Leading pilot demonstrations involving community uptake, training, or local implementation of technologies. | 100% (if non-profit) | Focus on high-TRL demonstration (TRL 5-8).

### Next Steps for Proposal Success

1.  **Review Work Programmes:** Carefully read the **Cluster 5 (Climate, Energy & Mobility)**, **Cluster 6 (Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources)**, and the **Mission Implementation Plans** to identify specific topics for 2025/2026.
2.  **Focus on Impact:** Proposals must clearly demonstrate how your NGO’s unique access to civil society strengthens the project's pathway to societal and policy impact.
3.  **Find Partners:** Use your existing networks and the Partner Search tool to join strong consortiums where your expertise complements technical/scientific research bodies.

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**

• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for Cluster 5 and 6
• Learn about EU Missions: [EU Missions Portal](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe/eu-missions-horizon-europe_en)
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
